audience: HR and payroll teams who run payroll in PaySpace

useCases.title: List active employees with their positions and departments
useCases.text: The AI lists the active employees of a company with employee number and dates, and their positions with organization unit, job and manager.

useCases.title: Total the payslip lines per employee for a month
useCases.text: The AI reads the payslip lines of a calendar month, one per component per employee, with code, description and amount, and adds them up per employee.

useCases.title: See the leave applications of a month
useCases.text: The AI lists leave applications with type, dates, days and status, for a year and month you give.

useCases.title: Find terminated employees
useCases.text: The AI lists all employees including terminated ones, and the employment status records with hire, termination, reason and dates.

useCases.title: Review the organization structure
useCases.text: The AI lists organization units (departments, divisions, cost centres), positions, jobs and regions of a company.

useCases.title: Check leave entitlements and manual adjustments
useCases.text: The AI lists leave entitlements with leave type and days per cycle, and the manual changes made to leave balances.
